lines.text: و اگر قمر مستعلی بود توالد و تناسل بسیار بود و نقصان گیاه باشد و توسط باران
lines.en: And if the Moon is dominant, procreation and reproduction will be abundant, and there will be a decrease in plants, and moderate rain.

lines.text: (اگر در سنبله باشد) دلالت کند بر رواج بازارها و کثرت معاملات و امدن کاروانها

lines.en: if Mercury is dominant, there will be much moisture. And if the Moon is dominant, there will be dryness of the air and little moisture. (The conjunction

lines.en: of the Moon and Mercury in the airy triplicity) indicates the prosperity of the business of the artisans and the wealthy and the scribes, and the abundance

lines.en: of food and drink, and the dryness of the air. (If it is in Gemini, it indicates the abundance of teaching and learning, and the sending

lines.en: of messengers and letters from parts to parts, and the good condition of travelers and merchants, and the corruption of the air, and the blowing of winds,

lines.en: of magics and incantations, especially talismans and other strange acts, and the buying and selling of slaves and beasts, and the prosperity

lines.en: of the market of books, and the arrival of ships, and the sale of water jewels, and the prosperity of the business of the common people and the professionals, and the humidity of the air.

summary.headline: Moon–Mercury Triplicity Forecasts
summary.text: Astrological forecasts for conjunctions of the Moon and Mercury in the earthy and airy triplicities, with separate predictions for Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn, and Gemini concerning rain, markets, travel, agriculture, rulers, scribes, physicians, astrologers, and occult practices.
